rotor_exclusion_policy: Only own artificial prop distribution and own motor envelope are excluded from external-obstacle scoring. Own motor full-slab intersections are separately retained, unresolved, and not accepted. Other rotor swept slabs are checked against each other. No material overlap is waived in the installed-object tests.

ground.method: Rotate actual geometry. Prescribe foot shortening along each actual tube axis. Translate the airframe until the lowest compressed foot geometry reaches the level foot-ground plane. A separately specified raised horizontal obstacle plane represents rotor-area terrain sensitivity, not an inferred terrain surface from foot heights.
ground.limitations: Bounding-box extrema are geometric observations. No contact forces, stiffness, damping, friction, equilibrium or settling are solved. Deformed legs and cables are not checked. One-foot shortening is a sensitivity, not evidence of achievable or stable compression. Positive samples are not continuous clearance.

mass_scope: Existing source report remains partial; this audit does not fill missing mass rows or qualify material densities.
